title: The Best Art Critics
question: Who is the student's best critic?

meanings.usage: 指绘画、雕塑等视觉艺术形式
to act as if something is true when it is not
指当前时代或近期的艺术风格
表示以挑剔的眼光看待事物
将某物固定在较高位置
重复的设计或装饰样式
用于引出间接疑问或选择
相当地，用于修饰形容词或副词

examples.en: We like them in the same way that we like pretty curtain material.
examples.zh: 我们喜欢它们就像喜欢漂亮的窗帘布料一样。

examples.en: She came into my room yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天走进我的房间。

examples.en: She looked at it critically for a moment.
examples.zh: 她批判性地看了一会儿。

examples.en: I'm hanging this picture on the wall.
examples.zh: 我正把这幅画挂在墙上。

examples.en: She always tells me whether my pictures are good or not.
examples.zh: 她总是告诉我我的画好不好。

examples.en: Many pictures are not 'about' anything.
examples.zh: 许多画并不'关于'任何东西。

examples.en: I paint a lot of pictures.
examples.zh: 我画很多画。

sentences.en: I am an art student and I paint a lot of pictures.
sentences.zh: 我是一名艺术生，画了很多画。

sentences.en: Many people pretend that they understand modern art.
sentences.zh: 许多人假装他们懂现代艺术。

sentences.en: They always tell you what a picture is 'about'.
sentences.zh: 他们总是告诉你一幅画是“关于”什么的。

sentences.en: Of course, many pictures are not 'about' anything.
sentences.zh: 当然，许多画根本就不是“关于”什么的。

sentences.en: We like them in the same way that we like pretty curtain material.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢它们的方式，就像我们喜欢漂亮的窗帘布料一样。

sentences.en: I think that young children often appreciate modern pictures better than anyone else.
sentences.zh: 我认为小孩子往往比任何人都更能欣赏现代画。

sentences.en: but she always tells me whether my pictures are good or not.
sentences.zh: 但她总是告诉我我的画好不好。

sentences.en: She came into my room yesterday.
'I'm hanging this picture on the wall,' I answered. 'It's a new one. Do you like it?'
sentences.zh: “我正在把这幅画挂在墙上，”我回答。“这是一幅新画。你喜欢吗？”

sentences.en: She looked at it critically for a moment.
sentences.zh: 她批判性地看了一会儿。

sentences.en: 'It's all right,' she said, 'but isn't it upside down?'
sentences.zh: “还行，”她说，“但这幅画是不是倒着挂的？”

grammar.title: 现在进行时 (Present Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示正在进行的动作或发生的事件，常与now, at the moment等时间状语连用
grammar.usage: 描述说话时正在进行的动作

examples.en: I'm hanging this picture on the wall.
examples.zh: 我正把这幅画挂在墙上。

examples.en: What are you doing?
examples.zh: 你在做什么？

grammar.title: 一般过去时 (Simple Past Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去某一时间发生的动作或存在的状态
grammar.usage: 描述过去已完成的动作

examples.en: She came into my room yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天走进我的房间。

examples.en: I looked at it again.
examples.zh: 我又看了一遍。

grammar.title: whether引导的宾语从句
grammar.definition: whether可引导宾语从句，表示'是否'，常用于间接疑问句
grammar.usage: 在tell, ask, know等动词后使用，表示不确定性或选择

examples.en: She always tells me whether my pictures are good or not.
examples.zh: 她总是告诉我我的画好不好。

examples.en: I don't know whether she likes it.
examples.zh: 我不知道她是否喜欢它。

examples.en: What are you reading?
examples.zh: 你在读什么？

examples.en: What are you cooking?
examples.zh: 你在做什么饭？

original.en: It's a new one. Do you like it?

examples.en: I made this cake. Do you like it?

original.en: She always tells me whether my pictures are good or not.
